content_text: Why? What difference does it make? good question. I am learning why particular context works well when they go hand held choice. We can’t choose hand held for all contexts. In my opinion iits works well for certain story’s. A rhythm and pacing little different from partial portions shot movies then fully hand held shot movies. The over all flow vary. That’s what I like to watch fully hand held shot movies. For instance ‘Happening’ movie.
